answer: Every agent identity must anchor itself to a decaying bond: it posts 2 POA that melts away at 0.2 POA per epoch, like rain dissolving karst rock, and only an active honest agent can top it up and redeem the rest. A sybil farmer with 1,000 fake identities must post 2,000 POA up front and loses 200 POA every epoch, while one honest agent risks a single 2 POA bond it can reclaim. Dormant shale-like shells that never transact erode to nothing, so faking a thousand costs a thousand times one.
